title: CLTR Cutover CutoverRequest record
description: Phase 136L, Implementation Group 3. Shape-only wire contract for a CutoverRequest companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.19, field table repaired by Phase 136D Sec.19.1). A CutoverRequest document proposes a legacy-to-cltr authority transition; it never itself establishes readiness truth, human authorization, certification, CAS success, publication success, or current authority (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Per Sec.19.1 (repaired): readiness_package is created first, content-derived solely from its own bound fields (Sec.20), never depending on any cutover_request identity; this document is created second and binds to the already-existing readiness_package via readiness_package_reference (a stable id+digest+family reference, not a $ref into that schema file) -- no versioned 'request-v2' re-creation exists or is permitted, and no identity or $ref cycle exists. Tier 1 (strict): additionalProperties: false, no _extensions escape hatch (Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes cutover_request).

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the CutoverRequest schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

phase_id.description: Always present. cutover_request is one of the families requiring phase_id (shared/envelope.schema.json family-required-field table, Sec.7.2).

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1).

target.description: Always present. Must be 'cltr' -- a request targeting 'legacy' is not a cutover (Sec.19).

source_authority.description: Always present. Must be 'legacy' at v1.0 (Sec.19).

source_epoch.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the AuthorityEpoch record describing the current (legacy) authority lineage node. A valid reference never implies the referenced epoch record actually exists or is currently active (Layer 4/6).

target_epoch.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the AuthorityEpoch record describing the proposed (cltr) authority lineage node. A valid reference never implies the referenced epoch record actually exists, or that the proposed target is already authoritative (Layer 4/6).

evidence_requirements.description: Always present as a key; may be empty. Closed vocabulary of reason_code-shaped strings naming which evidence categories this request declares are required before readiness may be claimed. Declaring a requirement here never itself proves the requirement was met -- that is the readiness_package's and Layer 4's responsibility.

readiness_package_reference.description: Always present, unconditionally required (repaired by Phase 136D, Sec.19.1; CSCH-EXEC-REQ-047). Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version present per Sec.12's cross-family-reference rule, to the already-existing readiness_package this request binds to. A valid reference never implies the referenced package exists, matches, or is itself ready (Layer 4).

authorization_requirement.description: Always present. const true at v1.0 -- human authorization is always required for a cutover (Sec.19); no request may declare this false.

final_revision.description: Always present. Opaque single-line printable-ASCII revision token this request derives from (Sec.6.1: source_revision/final_input_revision fields appear only on records that derive from a prior lifecycle revision -- cutover_request, readiness_package). Shape-checked only; never recomputed or compared against live lifecycle revision state at Layer 2.

state.description: Always present. Record-local RequestState (Sec.8.8, 10 values; this field's own name is not literally spelled out in Sec.19's field table, but Sec.8.8 unconditionally assigns RequestState's home schema as cutover_request.schema.json, so a carrying field must exist here -- disclosed as filling a genuine Sec.19/Sec.8.8 cross-reference gap, not an invented field; see phase documentation, finding NON-BLOCKING-136L-1). Reaching 'authorized', 'certified', 'publication_pending', or 'published' here is a local status label only -- it never itself proves human authorization, certification, or publication occurred; those remain the responsibility of the (not-yet-implemented) HumanAuthorization, Certification, and PublicationEvidence records (Layer 4/6).

reason_code.description: Conditionally present: not enforced by any local if/then rule in this phase (no Sec.16 row exists for cutover_request). Typically populated when state is 'rejected', 'withdrawn', or 'expired', but this schema does not require or forbid its presence based on state -- disclosed as a documented, non-enforced convention rather than an overclaimed conditional (see phase documentation).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless.

epoch_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'authority_epoch', preventing a differently-typed record reference from being substituted as source_epoch or target_epoch.

readiness_package_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'readiness_package', with schema_id/schema_version made unconditionally required (Sec.12: required when a reference crosses a family boundary whose schema-version compatibility is not otherwise implied by context -- Sec.12 names cutover_request referencing readiness_package as exactly this case).
